title: VK-only Write Single Coil with alternate unit and ordinary coil value
purpose: Exercise the server reply path with a valid single-coil write while varying the unit identifier and transaction context associated with issue-supported reply and repeated-processing concerns.

messages.label: write single coil at address 18, enabled

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the request and return a normal Write Single Coil response echoing the address and value; malformed or unsupported server behavior may instead produce an exception response or connection error.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 equals unit identifier plus the six-byte Write Single Coil PDU.
Unit identifier, function code, address, and coil value use recognizable field forms.
issue_safety_notes: This is a valid structural analogue only. It does not copy any reported crash payload and does not assert that the cited issue is triggered by this request.
